ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels account for approximately 85-90% of the surface area, with high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels concentrated at the distal tips accounting for the remaining 10-15%.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast light patches are localized at the distal extremities of both lobes. The left lobe distal tip features an irregular white region with internal dark mottling. The right lobe distal tip contains a larger, more diffuse light-colored zone. Sparse white micro-speckling is distributed across the central dark region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central depression with a vertex angle estimated at 65-75 degrees and a moderate depth-to-width ratio.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serrations (peaks and valleys) are visible along the entire trailing edge. The right lobe displays significantly higher amplitude indentations and larger notches compared to the left lobe, which shows more uniform, low-amplitude serrations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Both lobes exhibit a generally linear trajectory from the median notch that transitions into a slight convex curvature toward the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detected localized clusters of circular high-contrast white spots within the light-pigmented distal regions, particularly on the right lobe tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, unaligned linear light-colored streaks are visible on the dark pigmented area of the left lobe, oriented diagonally relative to the fluke's leading edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: The trailing edge of the right lobe shows significant irregular contour loss and jagged indentation, consistent with healed physical trauma or predation markings.
other_distinctive_markers: The extreme pigmentation contrast is strictly localized to the distal tips, creating a 'white-tipped' visual signature against an otherwise uniform dark fluke body.
